AbsolutePathBuf.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

AccountRateLimitsUpdatedNotification.description:
Sparse rolling rate-limit update.

Clients should merge available values into the most recent `account/rateLimits/read` response or refetch that snapshot. Nullable account metadata may be unavailable in a rolling update and does not clear a previously observed value.

extends.description: Parent profile identifier from the selected permissions profile's `extends` setting, when present.

id.description: Identifier from `default_permissions` or the implicit built-in default, such as `:workspace` or a user-defined `[permissions.<id>]` profile.

CodexErrorInfo.description:
This translation layer make sure that we expose codex error code in camel case.

When an upstream HTTP status is available (for example, from the Responses API or a provider), it is forwarded in `httpStatusCode` on the relevant `codexErrorInfo` variant.

stopCause.description: Execution scheduling cause, independent of lifecycle and task acceptance.

CollaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode for a Codex session.

path.description: Absolute path in the executor's native path convention, not the host's.

CommandExecOutputDeltaNotification.description:
Base64-encoded output chunk emitted for a streaming `command/exec` request.

These notifications are connection-scoped. If the originating connection closes, the server terminates the process.

capReached.description: `true` on the final streamed chunk for a stream when `outputBytesCap` truncated later output on that stream.

processId.description: Client-supplied, connection-scoped `processId` from the original `command/exec` request.

oneOf.description: stdout stream. PTY mode multiplexes terminal output here.
stderr stream.

decodingLossy.description: Whether invalid UTF-8 was replaced while decoding this delta.

stream.description: Origin of this delta; absent only for legacy producers.

failure_cause.description: Harness/observation failure, not a program exit status or stderr bytes.

process_exited.description: Process termination and output drain are independent observations.

raw_output_artifact_id.description: Existing retained-output locator, when available at delivery time.

search_no_match.description: Conservative owner-classified search miss; the raw exit code remains 1.

details.description: Optional extra guidance or error details.

path.description: Optional path to the config file that triggered the warning.

range.description: Optional range for the error location inside the config file.

details.description: Optional extra guidance, such as migration steps or rationale.

summary.description: Concise summary of what is deprecated.

ownerId.description: Opaque registration/logical-session identity captured before dispatch.

willRetry.description: Whether the server will retry automatically. When true, the turn remains active; clients should not initiate a duplicate retry for this notification.

FileChangeEffects.description: Ordered committed endpoint receipts. `exact=false` means additional effects may be unknown; an empty list then is not proof that nothing changed.

FileSystemAccessMode.description:
Access mode for a filesystem entry.

When two equally specific entries target the same path, we compare these by conflict precedence rather than by capability breadth: `deny` beats `write`, and `write` beats `read`.

oneOf.description: `none` is a legacy input alias retained temporarily for compatibility.
A git-style glob pattern. Pattern entries currently support FileSystemAccessMode::Deny only.
oneOf.title: GlobPatternFileSystemPath_for_AbsolutePathBuf

oneOf.description: WARNING: `:special_path` tokens are part of config compatibility. Do not make older runtimes reject newly introduced tokens. New parser support should be additive, while unknown values must stay representable so config from a newer Codex degrades to warn-and-ignore instead of failing to load. Codex 0.112.0 rejected unknown values here, which broke forward compatibility for newer config. Preserves future special-path tokens so older runtimes can ignore them without rejecting config authored by a newer release.

walkComplete.description: False if scanning was skipped or paths were omitted due to limits, cancellation, or errors.

results.description: Terminal results are delivered even if best-effort progress updates were lost. Absent only in legacy server payloads; absence does not prove completeness.

totalMatchCount.description: Matches found among scanned entries, before the result limit is applied. Zero when the query is empty and results are suppressed.

walkComplete.description: True only after scanning and current-query matching finish without omissions. False during matching, or when limits, cancellation or errors interrupt search.

reported.description: False means a response was observed but supplied no usable usage object.

PlanDeltaNotification.description: EXPERIMENTAL - proposed plan streaming deltas for plan items. Clients should not assume concatenated deltas match the completed plan item content.

stderr.description:
Buffered stderr capture.

Empty when stderr was streamed via `process/outputDelta`.

stderrCapReached.description:
Whether stderr reached `outputBytesCap`.

In streaming mode, stderr is empty and cap state is also reported on the final stderr `process/outputDelta` notification.

stdout.description:
Buffered stdout capture.

Empty when stdout was streamed via `process/outputDelta`.

stdoutBase64.description: Exact undelivered stdout suffix, appended after streamed raw deltas. When present use these bytes, not the lossy legacy text projection.

stdoutCapReached.description:
Whether stdout reached `outputBytesCap`.

In streaming mode, stdout is empty and cap state is also reported on the final stdout `process/outputDelta` notification.

stdoutCapture.description: Root exit does not establish output EOF; post-exit drain is bounded independently of the execution timeout and byte cap.

ProcessOutputCaptureState.description: Per-stream capture facts, independent of the root process exit status. Complete capture requires `reachedEof` and neither limit flag. A closed producer without EOF can indicate read failure or forced reader shutdown.

ProcessOutputDeltaNotification.description: Base64-encoded output chunk emitted for a streaming `process/spawn` request.

capReached.description: True on the final streamed chunk for this stream when output was truncated by `outputBytesCap`.

stream.description: Output stream this chunk belongs to.

oneOf.description: stdout stream. PTY mode multiplexes terminal output here.
stderr stream.

spendControlReached.description: Backend-reported spend-control state. `None` is unavailable, not a sparse-update recovery.

ReasoningEffort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

ReasoningSummary.description: A summary of the reasoning performed by the model. This can be useful for debugging and understanding the model's reasoning process. See https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#reasoning-summaries

oneOf.description: Option to disable reasoning summaries.

RemoteControlStatusChangedNotification.description: Current remote-control connection status and remote identity exposed to clients.

ResponseQueueTiming.description: Observed host queue costs, NOT provider compute or additive wall-clock time. Sums include only enqueued/dequeued events; cancellation can censor a send or leave events queued. Terminal receipt is independent of provider usage.

SkillsChangedNotification.description:
Notification emitted when watched local skill files change.

Treat this as an invalidation signal and re-run `skills/list` with the client's current parameters when refreshed skill metadata is needed.

SurfacedToolResult.description: Authoritative typed tool result surfaced as the terminal result of a turn. `canonical_message`, when present, is owner-authored and may be copied unchanged into legacy last-message consumers. `value` is never rendered into synthetic assistant prose by the host.

byteRange.description: Byte range in the parent `text` buffer that this element occupies.

placeholder.description: Optional human-readable placeholder for the element, displayed in the UI.

agentNickname.description: Optional random unique nickname assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.

agentRole.description: Optional role (agent_role) assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.

cliVersion.description: Version of the CLI that created the thread.

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was created.

cwd.description: Working directory captured for the thread.

ephemeral.description: Whether the thread is ephemeral and should not be materialized on disk.

forkedFromId.description: Source thread id when this thread was created by forking another thread.

gitInfo.description: Optional Git metadata captured when the thread was created.

id.description: Identifier for this thread. Codex-generated thread IDs are UUIDv7.

modelProvider.description: Model provider used for this thread (for example, 'openai').

parentThreadId.description: The ID of the parent thread. This will only be set if this thread is a subagent.

path.description: [UNSTABLE] Path to the thread on disk.

preview.description: Usually the first user message in the thread, if available.

projectId.description: Canonical project assignment owned by app-server, if any.

recencyAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) used for thread recency ordering.

sessionId.description: Session id shared by threads that belong to the same session tree.

source.description: Origin of the thread (CLI, VSCode, codex exec, codex app-server, etc.).

status.description: Current runtime status for the thread.

threadSource.description: Optional analytics source classification for this thread.

turns.description: Only populated on `thread/resume`, `thread/rollback`, `thread/fork`, and `thread/read` (when `includeTurns` is true) responses. For all other responses and notifications returning a Thread, the turns field will be an empty list.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was last updated.

ThreadExtra.description: Extra app-server data for a thread.

aggregatedOutput.description: The command's output, aggregated from stdout and stderr.

commandActions.description: A best-effort parsing of the command to understand the action(s) it will perform. This returns a list of CommandAction objects because a single shell command may be composed of many commands piped together.

durationMs.description: The duration of the command execution in milliseconds.

executionId.description: Unique dispatch execution id used by timing and lifecycle records.

parentCallId.description: Model-visible exec call that owns a nested code-mode command.

parentCellId.description: Stable code-mode cell that issued the nested command.

processId.description: Identifier for the underlying PTY process (when available).

runtimeToolCallId.description: Runtime invocation id within the owning code-mode cell.

durationMs.description: The duration of the MCP tool call in milliseconds.
The duration of the dynamic tool call in milliseconds.

agentsStates.description: Last known status of the target agents, when available.

id.description: Unique identifier for this collab tool call.

model.description: Model requested for the spawned agent, when applicable.

prompt.description: Prompt text sent as part of the collab tool call, when available.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort requested for the spawned agent, when applicable.

receiverThreadIds.description: Thread ID of the receiving agent, when applicable. In case of spawn operation, this corresponds to the newly spawned agent.

senderThreadId.description: Thread ID of the agent issuing the collab request.

status.description: Current status of the collab tool call.

tool.description: Name of the collab tool that was invoked.

status.description: Absent on historical/hosted items whose terminal outcome was not recorded.

providerUsage.description: Separate image-model receipt; never add these tokens to text inference.

omittedImageCount.description: Images dropped from the retained task input.

omittedText.description: Whether earlier text was dropped rather than summarized in place.

retainedImageCount.description: Images kept in the retained task input.

tokensAfter.description: Active context tokens after the replacement.

tokensBefore.description: Active context tokens before the replacement.

environments.description: Ordered applied selection; first is primary, empty disables environment access. Absent only when restoring legacy settings without selection information.

estimatedContextTokens.description: Local active-context estimate, not observed provider consumption.

TokenUsageCoverage.description: Constant-space receipt/component coverage. Counts add and subtract with the existing usage ledger, so an earlier missing receipt does not taint later turns.

cache_write_input_tokens.description: Sum of the explicitly reported cache-write input class, not an estimate. Interpret with cache_write_receipts; an absent class is never known zero.

reported_receipts.description: Whole usage objects received. None preserves legacy coverage uncertainty.

ToolLifecycleContext.description: Queue and waiter state captured at a lifecycle boundary.

ToolLifecycleTimerWait.description: Attribution for a bounded or sticky lifecycle wait.

completedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the turn completed.

durationMs.description: Duration between turn start and completion in milliseconds, if known.

error.description: Only populated when the Turn's status is failed.

id.description: Identifier for this turn. Codex-generated turn IDs are UUIDv7.

items.description: Thread items currently included in this turn payload.

itemsView.description: Describes how much of `items` has been loaded for this turn.

startedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the turn started.

surfacedResult.description: Authoritative typed tool result surfaced when the turn terminalized.

timing.description: Immutable wall-clock profile persisted at the terminal turn boundary.

taskDisposition.description: Versioned declared-scope verdict, independent of diagnostic severity. Missing on older records means unavailable, never inferred complete.

validationUncertainty.description: Bounded unresolved questions for resume. Never passing proof or live handles.

TurnDiffUpdatedNotification.description: Notification that the turn-level unified diff has changed. Contains the latest aggregated diff across all file changes in the turn.

TurnFinalAnswer.description: Accepted user-facing answer from one completion attempt. Kept separately from last-visible-message evidence, which may include commentary or errors.

tail.description: Absent in older records. Final-specific observations, not task acceptance.

TurnFinalTail.description: Version 1 counts Unicode scalar values, UTF-8 bytes and nonempty Unicode whitespace-separated words in the canonical final, once. No token estimate is inferred. Times are monotonic offsets from this core turn's start.

nativeRenderAck.description: Requires a capable native client. Server writer receipts are NOT render acknowledgments and cannot populate this field.

reconciledHostMs.description: Host observation of the admitted final candidate, not proof that every user obligation or external evidence source was reconciled.

requiredEvidence.description: Unknown unless an authoritative task oracle supplies required evidence; never substitute the most recent tool, status call, or plan completion.

oneOf.description: `items` was not loaded for this turn. The field is intentionally empty.
`items` contains only a display summary for this turn.
`items` contains every ThreadItem available from persisted app-server history for this turn.

TurnTaskDisposition.description: Host assessment of a finite declared contract, not all natural-language intent.

TurnTiming.description:
Immutable wall-clock profile captured at the core terminal boundary.

`exclusive` is the canonical elapsed-time partition. Values in `unions` and `local` may overlap and must not be added to that partition.

activityTimeline.description: Bounded occurrence intervals in a named process clock domain. Missing evidence must not be reconstructed from scalar totals or wall epochs.

checkoutSnapshotSha256.description: Content identity of tracked and non-ignored untracked files captured before this turn's tools ran. Absent means capture was unavailable.

completionAssessment.description: Completion diagnostics captured at the terminal boundary. These are independent of execution status and timing validity; empty diagnostics are not proof that the user's entire task was verified.

creditDelta.description: Observed starting minus ending account credit balance, not an isolated invoice: concurrent turns, replenishments, or delayed reports may affect it.

deterministicContinuationReceipts.description: Bounded, aggregated host-managed continuation receipts. Resource identities are hashes; raw paths and payloads are never included.

finalAnswer.description: Accepted answer identity frozen after completion hooks and pending-input admission. Some with no message explicitly means no accepted answer; absence is legacy unknown. This is not the last visible/partial message.

machineDurationNs.description: Inclusive duration minus only the interactive-only wait partition.

modelRequestHistoryTruncated.description: True qualifies all history-derived purpose, failure, wait-signature and nonprogress aggregates as retained-tail lower bounds. None is legacy unknown.

modelRequests.description: Per-sampling-request milestones, ordered by request. Times are offsets from turn start and are diagnostic only; they are not additive buckets.

observationalNonprogressLatency.description: Latency observed on the same no-recorded-progress, unchanged-state generations as `observational_nonprogress_tokens`. Model-stream wait remains a model-side wall-clock measurement; `decision_latency_ns` narrows that to dispatch-to-first-actionable-output where observable.

observationalNonprogressTokens.description: Provider usage observed on generations with no recorded progress kinds and unchanged relevant state. A changed next action alone is not progress under this predicate; useful inference or diagnosis may still occur. Final-answer publication is excluded. This observational diagnostic is neither measured avoidable savings nor authority to stop a turn.

stopCause.description: Scheduling cause, not an acceptance verdict. Absent on older records.

terminalPublicationDurationExcluded.description: Frozen-core duration excludes subsequent detail export and event enqueue; it is not a client-delivery or terminal-publication latency measurement.

terminalization.description: Legacy timings from the retired turn-finalization pipeline. Absent or null means not measured; current runtimes omit this field.

toolCallDetailsArtifactId.description: Optional full per-call lifecycle detail in the thread's tool-output artifact store. Subject to that store's retention policy; aggregate timings and per-call summary fields remain usable without the artifact.

toolCalls.description: Bounded per-call relay timings captured at delivery. Offsets are from turn start; phase durations are diagnostics and are not additive with the canonical `exclusive` partition.

toolClosure.description: Exact accepted-call closure ledger. A terminal event is publishable only when every accepted direct and nested execution has timing, a terminal outcome, and exactly one persisted projection.

phase.description: One of the ten canonical exclusive bucket names (without the Ns suffix).

processInFlight.description: Observed process flight, NOT guarded tool runtime or CPU execution.

exclusiveNs.description: Canonical exclusive phase names to durations; sums to end minus start.

unionsNs.description: Union durations named after interval flags, plus modelProcessOverlap and modelToolOverlap. Missing keys are measured zero, not unknown. Values overlap and must not be added to the exclusive partition.

attributableRecoveryGenerationCount.description: Tool-result generations immediately following an observed direct `read_tool_output` recovery transaction. In-cell reads are counted separately. This is independent of whether the recovered projection was truncated again.

continuationAfterTruncationCount.description: Tool-result generations immediately following provider-visible output that actually omitted or truncated canonical tool information. Temporal succession only: this does not establish an extra generation caused by truncation. Historical causal spelling is accepted on input.

executedValidationDurationNs.description: Total wall-clock nanoseconds spent in validation commands that executed.

logicalGenerationCount.description: Logical workflow generations. `model_request_count` remains the authoritative physical transport-attempt aggregate in timing schema 34+: each identity is counted once at transport entry, including internal auth retries. This does not prove provider receipt. Older schemas may count only the first dispatch/readiness in a sampling row.

modelRequestDetailEvictionCount.description: Bounded detail loss; diagnostics derived from request rows cover only retained detail when either eviction counter is nonzero.

ownerDrainedContinuationCount.description: Continuations drained and recorded by their code-mode owner.

purposeAggregates.description: Bounded to the stable purpose enum's cardinality.

readyStartupPrewarmCount.description: Ready startup prewarms observed by the first model request.

residualDeterministicGenerationCount.description: Residual deterministic generation requests proved by turn execution. Null means production execution control does not measure this counter.

suppressedDeterministicContinuationCount.description: Authoritative number of model boundaries suppressed by accepted deterministic-continuation receipts. A receipt whose `suppressed_continuation_count` is N contributes N, not one. Invalid, rejected, and zero-count receipts contribute nothing. This counter is independent of `generations_by_disposition`.

toolOutputBudgetDropCount.description: Tool results the aggregate output budget dropped across every request this turn actually sent. Preparing an unchanged projection again adds nothing; only a dispatched request contributes.

toolOutputBudgetDroppedTokenCount.description: Tokens those dropped results would have occupied.

toolOutputInCellRecoveryCallCount.description: Recovery transactions performed inside code-mode cells, without a separate provider tool-result generation.

waitGenerationsWithSameRevisionCount.description: Wait generations sharing coarse revisions; this does not establish that the wait action, cursor, or owner state repeated.

expectedUsageCount.description: Expected physical usage reports; absent in legacy aggregates.

observedUsageCount.description: Attributable reports observed. Totals are lower bounds unless equal to expected.

outputExcludingReportedReasoningTokens.description: Same provider remainder as the per-request canonical field. Retained window only when TurnTiming.model_request_history_truncated is true.

visibleOutputTokens.description: Deprecated compatibility remainder; never add it to the canonical field.

decisionLatencyNs.description: Sum of dispatch-to-first-actionable-output latency for requests where an actionable output was observed.

expectedUsageCount.description: Expected physical usage reports; absent in legacy aggregates.

observedUsageCount.description: Attributable reports observed. Totals are lower bounds unless equal to expected.

outputExcludingReportedReasoningTokens.description: Provider remainder, not visible/final text. Completeness also requires TurnTiming.model_request_history_truncated == Some(false).

toolActiveUnionNs.description: Sum of per-generation unioned tool-active durations. Parallel tools within one generation are not double-counted.

visibleOutputTokens.description: Deprecated compatibility remainder; never add it to the canonical field.

planningCompactionOverlapUnionNs.description: Time simultaneously attributed to planning and compaction.

planningExclusiveUnionNs.description: Planning union with nested compaction overlap removed.

planningUnionNs.description: Inclusive planning union, including any nested compaction.

firstAssistantTextItemId.description: Item identity when supplied by the published event.

firstAssistantTextMs.description: First nonempty assistant text accepted by the post-filter host queue; reasoning, completed messages and native paint are separate milestones.

firstAssistantTextPhase.description: Phase when supplied by the published event; absent is unknown.

firstDomainActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized domain-work handler is entered.

firstInfrastructureActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized control/plumbing tool handler is entered.

firstRequestPreparationStartedMs.description: First ordinary request-preparation entry before any provider dispatch. The preceding span includes initial turn setup, not provider work.

firstSuccessfulDomainActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool completes successfully.

firstSuccessfulUsefulActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool completes successfully.

firstToolAcceptedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first tool call is accepted for dispatch.

firstToolDiscoveryActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized tool-schema discovery handler is entered.

firstToolGateAdmittedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first tool call passes the parallel gate.

firstToolHandlerEntryMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized tool handler is entered.

firstUsefulActionMs.description: Time from turn start until the first authorized domain-work tool handler is entered.

firstUsefulToolAcceptedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool is accepted for dispatch.

firstUsefulToolGateAdmittedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first domain-work tool passes the parallel gate.

turnWorkerStartedMs.description: Worker entry after the task-installation barrier, from turn start. Absent is unknown; it must not be reconstructed from wall timestamps.

userInputRecordedMs.description: Time from turn start until the first user input begins durable recording.

decisionLatencyNs.description: Dispatch-to-first-actionable-output latency. This excludes reasoning deltas and partial tool arguments; missing actionable output stays null.

executorAdmittedToolCallCount.description: Direct model-issued calls that acquired the executor admission gate.

executorMaxConcurrentToolCalls.description: Peak direct model-issued calls holding executor admission concurrently.

fixedPrefixReuseEligible.description: Whether this logical request exactly matched the preceding stable prompt prefix under the same prompt-cache identity.

generationIndex.description: Zero-based logical generation owning this physical provider attempt.

generationPurpose.description: Stable workflow purpose for the logical generation. Physical retries inherit this value from their owning generation.

modelEmittedToolCallCount.description: Tool calls parsed from completed model output before relay persistence or executor polling. Recorded on the generation's primary attempt.

modelStreamWaitNs.description: Directly observed model-stream wait for this physical attempt.

nextStructuredActionChanged.description: False only after the next completed continuation is observed choosing the same complete ordered tool actions (names and arguments). True also covers an unknown or unobserved next action; this is not a completion test.

physicalAttemptIds.description: Physical provider attempts observed for this logical request, including retries and transport fallbacks.

promptCacheKeyFingerprint.description: Stable SHA-256 fingerprint of the prompt cache key sent to the provider. The raw key is intentionally not persisted in timing diagnostics.

relevantStateFingerprint.description: A redacted hash of only the structured state relevant to this request.

requestDiagnosticsStatus.description: Optional diagnostics can finish after the turn. Late diagnostic records use sampling_request_id and physical_attempt_id to update this row.

requestSectionSha256ByAttempt.description: Hashes of serialized top-level transport fields, captured at dispatch even when optional prompt/token diagnostics have not finished.

requestSha256ByAttempt.description: SHA-256 of the exact serialized transport body for each dispatched physical attempt. Includes retry bodies and websocket deltas.

requestTokenCategories.description: Full logical prompt accounting and section hashes. No prompt text, repository paths, or tool arguments are persisted here.

responseIdByAttempt.description: Provider response IDs retained so offline replay preserves websocket continuation requests rather than inventing new response identities.

responseQueueTimingByAttempt.description: Host queue observations by physical attempt, then api_to_mapper or mapper_to_turn stage. Missing stages are unknown, not zero. Queue sums overlap provider work and each other; never subtract them from model wait to invent provider computation time.

samplingRequestId.description: Stable identity shared by every physical provider attempt for this logical request.

setupPhaseNs.description: Named setup-phase union durations in nanoseconds, frozen at dispatch. Measured from request preparation (or attempt start for retries), not cumulative across the turn. Phases can overlap and must not be summed. Empty for older records or attempts that never dispatched.

streamDeliveryByAttempt.description: Versioned content-free JSON delivery summaries by retained physical attempt. Chunks are decoded deltas, not individual provider tokens.

tokenUsage.description: Provider-reported usage for this physical attempt. Missing usage stays null, including failed attempts for which the provider reported none.

toolActiveUnionNs.description: Unioned tool-active duration attributed to this generation. Parallel tool calls are counted once per wall-clock interval.

toolCallCount.description: Unique tool calls accepted for this generation, including unpolled calls. Timing schemas <=32 counted calls at executor polling instead.

outputExcludingReportedReasoningTokens.description: Provider output minus explicitly reported reasoning, not visible text.

visibleOutputTokens.description: Deprecated compatibility remainder. Not a final-answer text count; consult coverage and the canonical optional field before interpreting it.

fixedPrefixChangedCategories.description: Fixed-prefix categories whose exact hash differed from the preceding request. Non-empty explains why fixed-prefix reuse was ineligible.

historyFirstDivergentIndex.description: First input index whose digest differs from the preceding request's.

historyItemsPrevious.description:
Input items the preceding request sent, from this request's own comparison. Absent on the first request of a comparison chain, which has no predecessor to diverge from.

A whole-history digest changes on every request by design, so it cannot distinguish appending from rewriting. These three fields can: with `history_prefix_items_reused == history_items_previous` the request only appended, and a smaller `history_first_divergent_index` locates where the prefix was rewritten or truncated instead.

historyPrefixItemsReused.description: Leading input items identical to the preceding request's.

localInputEstimate.description: One-pass local estimate over the complete serialized logical prompt.

localReconciliationResidual.description: `local_input_estimate - logical_total`. This exposes estimator and JSON envelope effects instead of silently assigning them to a category.

logicalTotal.description: Sum of the mutually exclusive category estimates above.

promptSectionSha256.description: Exact content hashes from prompt provenance, not the state fingerprint.

providerInputTokens.description: Provider-reported full input tokens, when usage was returned.

repeatedUnchangedContext.description: Overlapping diagnostic: logical tokens in categories whose exact hash matched the preceding request. This is not added to `logical_total`.

toolOutputBudgetDropCount.description:
Tool results the aggregate output budget dropped from the representation this request actually sent.

Attributed to one request and one representation: the budget runs over several candidate projections, and summing them would count drops that never reached the model.

toolOutputBudgetDroppedTokenCount.description: Tokens those dropped results would have occupied.

toolOutputSerializedBytes.description: Serialized tool-result bytes in this request's full logical input, including retained results. Subset of conversation_history; not transport bytes.

toolOutputTokensEstimate.description: Native tool-result token estimate for this request's full logical input, including retained results. Subset of conversation_history; not provider usage.

clockDomainId.description: Absent for clocks without proven alignment (including legacy records).

coarseIntervals.description: Complete, bounded suffix summaries after exact interval retention fills. Order inside a summary is unknown. Checkpoints carry the entire current suffix, replacing (not appending to) the preceding coarse snapshot.

coverageIncludingCoarseComplete.description: Complete elapsed coverage including coarse summaries, not exact ordering. Absent for legacy records; independent of exact `coverage_complete`.

openProcessCount.description: Processes still observed in flight at the frozen window end are censored.

startedAtNs.description: Turn start in the named process domain; intervals below are turn-relative.

tailUnknown.description: Checkpoints do not assert a terminal endpoint.

TurnTimingTokenCategoryBasis.description:
Semantic basis used by request token-category accounting.

Categories describe the complete logical prompt presented to the model. They do not describe only websocket deltas, newly allocated client memory, uncached provider input, or reconciliation residuals.

TurnTimingToolCall.description:
Relay and persistence lifecycle for one model-issued or nested tool call.

All `*_at_ms` values are monotonic offsets from turn start. A missing boundary means the call ended before that boundary was observed. No tool arguments, output, or paths are persisted; nested identifiers are opaque correlation keys only.

backgroundProcessExpected.description: A retained running process is expected only when the response returned a background process identifier for a later `write_stdin` call.

deliveredAtMs.description: Historical relay-completion boundary. This predates persistence timing and therefore does not prove that the output reached conversation history or the rollout recorder.

execCleanupStateObserved.description: The exec handler reached its post-cleanup process-store observation.

lifecycleEvents.description: Exact event-site lifecycle records. Older timestamp fields remain as compatibility projections of these boundaries.

modelResumedAtMs.description: The next model generation began after this result became model-visible.

outcome.description: Payload-free terminal classification reported by the tool runtime.

outputCollectedAtMs.description: The tool result has been collected into the host relay, before any post-handler evidence, projection, persistence, or delivery work.

outputModelVisibleAtMs.description: The direct tool output was committed to model-visible conversation history. Durable rollout persistence is tracked independently by the tool-closure ledger. Nested code-mode calls are represented by the outer direct tool output and leave this absent.

parentCallId.description: Model-visible outer tool call that owns this nested call, when any.

parentCellId.description: Runtime cell that issued this nested tool request, when any.

readyToSampleToDispatchNs.description: Monotonic latency from the host proving that sampling is unblocked to the provider request reaching its transport dispatch boundary.

runningProcessAfterCleanup.description: The process manager still retained this call after foreground cleanup.

runtimeToolCallId.description: Code-mode's payload-free per-cell invocation id, when any.

workspaceEvidenceBeforeCacheHit.description: Whether the pre-handler workspace identity came from the latest authoritative capture instead of running a fresh capture.

workspaceEvidenceBeforeTimedOutGitDepend.description: Git dependencies that crossed the bounded capture deadline during a fresh pre-handler workspace capture.

TurnTimingToolCallIdentity.description: Payload-free identity for one accepted tool execution in the terminal closure ledger.

TurnTimingToolClosure.description:
Reconciliation summary for all accepted tool executions in a turn.

`complete` is true for a turn with no accepted calls. Otherwise it requires every accepted execution to have a timing record, terminal outcome, and exactly-once persisted projection, with no orphan or duplicate lifecycle records and no ledger overflow.

measurementAvailable.description: False when a legacy record omitted the entire closure ledger. Its zero counts and incomplete verdict are unavailable evidence, not observations.

TurnTimingToolLifecycleEvent.description: Exact event-site timestamp from the turn's single monotonic clock.

text_elements.description: UI-defined spans within `text` used to render or persist special elements.

message.description: Concise warning message for the user.

threadId.description: Optional thread target when the warning applies to a specific thread.
